corpus.note: Cross-corpus CKA between wiki- and chat-fitted Jacobians. Early layers are corpus-dependent; from ~38% depth (the workspace-band onset) transport is corpus-invariant (CKA ≥0.84).

replication.headline: holds on disjoint prompts — n=1 closes 82% of the gap (orig 79%), n=2 96%; at n≥5 the fresh lens matches the n=1000 reference outright
replication.b27: 27B partial: 3 singles, layer-graded variance pattern reproduces; n-curve pending a GPU window

len_sweep.headline: an 8-token prompt matches a full 128-token single (~80% of the gap); 2 tokens still closes ~48%; 1 token is impossible (the estimator needs a position before the last)

meta._source: Curated from writeup.md (tables 3.1, 3.5, 3.6) — the 27B literal replication. Ranks are full-vocabulary (~150k tokens); 0 = top token. Ranks >= 100 were never printed by the probe and are recorded here as null.

lcm._source: Curated from writeup.md Phase 1 (2026-07-23) + Phase 2 (2026-07-24). Raw: data/lcm_probe_27b_r*_raw.json, data/lcm_probe_27b_r5.json, data/lcm_steer_27b.json, data/steer_swap_27b_r*.json.
lcm.headline: The post's gcd/LCM 'meta-value' replicates as a READ (with the controls the post lacked) — and is causally INERT as a WRITE.

read.replicates: 11/11 non-trivial single-token-gcd cases: g surfaces in the mid-band (L24–56) top-8 at pre-answer positions; 8/11 at rank 0–1, typical p 0.05–0.18 (e.g. lcm(27,90): ' 9' rank 1 at L40, two positions before '270')
read.controls: coprime pairs (g=1): never rank ≤3, p ≤0.017; rounds 4–5 pick g that is not a digit of a or b, killing the copy-echo confound
read.paraphrase: 'find the smallest positive number both 18 and 30 divide evenly into' (no LCM vocabulary) still reads g at rank 0 — semantic, not lexical
read.boundary: two-digit gcds (12, 15, 11) never surface while answers stay correct — the readable register is one token wide

write.method: rank-1 projection swap h' = h − (h·d₉)d₉ + α(h·d₉)d₃ along the exact lens read-directions, completion prompt, greedy decoding; post predicts lcm(27,90): 270 → 810
rows: swap across the readout band L39–45
write.verdict: never flips — the lens reads the gcd faithfully but the subspace it reads is not the register the arithmetic runs through. Third documented read≠write failure (additive push, rank-1 swap, rank-1 ablation).

lcm.additive_steer: additive push of the ' 3' direction: ≤0.2 no-op, 0.35–0.6 mutes the reply entirely (immediate EOS, unexplained), ≥1.2 token spam — never a swap
